terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using the Ketamiz platform.
terms.qSubtitle: Our support team is always here to help you understand your rights and obligations.

section1.title: 1. General Rules
section1.content: Ketamiz.com is a platform designed to organize trips between users (clients) and drivers. By using the platform, you fully agree to these terms. If you do not agree to these terms, you may not use the platform.

section2.title: 2. User Types
section2.content: There are 2 types of users on the platform: Client — trip booker, Driver — trip provider.

section3.title: 3. Booking Rules
section3.content: When a client books a trip: Payment is deducted from the balance in advance. Seats are reserved after the booking is confirmed. Clients cannot book their own trips (even if they are a driver).

section4.title: 4. Payment and Balance
section4.content: For Client: Payment is deducted at the time of booking. If the balance is insufficient, the booking will not proceed. For Driver: Payment is credited to the balance after the booking is confirmed. The platform deducts a service fee.

section5.title: 5. Service Fee (Commission)
section5.content: The platform charges a commission for each booking. Commission may be applied at the time of booking or cancellation. Commission is non-refundable (unless otherwise stated in the terms).

section6.title: 6. Adding a Passenger
section6.content: A client can add a new passenger to an existing booking. For each additional passenger: A separate fee is charged, and money is deducted from the balance. If no seats are available, adding is not possible.

section7.title: 7. Removing a Passenger
section7.content: A client can remove a passenger if: At least 2 hours remain before the trip starts. Refund: A portion of the payment is returned, and the service fee is retained.

section8.title: 8. Cancelling a Booking
section8.content: Cancellation is possible: Only at least 2 hours before the trip starts. When cancelled: A portion of the money is returned to the client, and a cancellation fee is retained. Driver: Money may be deducted from the balance or compensation may be provided as a result of cancellation.

section9.title: 9. Trip Status
section9.content: A trip can be in the following states: active — available, full — no seats left, cancelled — aborted, completed — finished. If seats run out, it automatically becomes full.

section10.title: 10. Responsibility
section10.content: Ketamiz.com: Not fully responsible for the real trip between the driver and the client. Serves only as a platform. Driver: Responsible for passenger safety. Client: Must enter correct information.

section11.title: 11. Balance and Transactions
section11.content: Every payment is recorded. The platform maintains a history of Debits (deductions) and Credits (additions).

section12.title: 12. Fraud and Misuse
section12.content: The following are prohibited: Fake bookings, false information, bypassing payment. In such cases: The account will be blocked and the balance may be frozen.

section13.title: 13. Changes
section13.content: Ketamiz.com reserves the right to change these terms at any time.

section14.title: 14. Consent
section14.content: By registering, the user: Fully agrees to these terms and is obligated to follow platform rules.

section15.title: 15. Viewing and Using Trips
section15.content: Users can view all active and full trips on the platform. Each trip is presented based on route, time, price, and available seats.

section16.title: 16. Accessing Trip Details
section16.content: Users can view trip details under the following conditions: Full (detailed) view is only available for trips they have booked. Other trips are shown in a general view only.

section17.title: 17. Trip Statuses (Important)
section17.content: Trips have the following statuses on the platform: 🟢 Active — Trip available, booking possible. 🔴 Full — All seats occupied, no new bookings accepted. 🟡 In Progress — Trip started, changes are limited. ⚫ Completed — Trip finished, no changes or refunds possible. ❌ Cancelled — Trip or booking cancelled.

section18.title: 18. In Progress
section18.content: A trip is considered in progress if: Start time ≤ current time and End time ≥ current time. Restrictions: Cannot add passengers, cannot cancel, no refunds.

section19.title: 19. Completed
section19.content: After the trip ends: No refunds are issued, booking cannot be changed, and the platform considers all transactions finalized.

section20.title: 20. Cancelled Trips
section20.content: Cancelled trips are saved in history, remain visible to the user, and cannot be restored.

section21.title: 21. User History
section21.content: The platform shows the user: Cancelled trips, ongoing trips, and completed trips. This information is private to the user and not shown to others.

section22.title: 22. Time Constraints (CRITICAL)
section22.content: The following time rules apply on the platform: At least 2 hours before trip starts: Cancellation is possible. Less than 2 hours before trip starts: Cancellation is prohibited, and passengers cannot be removed.

section23.title: 23. Data Accuracy
section23.content: Users must correctly enter: Name, Phone, and Location. Incorrect data may lead to booking cancellation, and the platform is not responsible.

section24.title: 24. Platform Limitations
section24.content: Ketamiz.com: Not responsible for trip delays and does not fully answer for disputes between driver and client. It is only an intermediary platform.

section25.title: 25. Technical Errors
section25.content: The platform is not responsible for: Internet outages, server errors, or payment system issues.

section26.title: 26. Account Blocking
section26.content: Accounts will be blocked for: Excessive cancellations (abuse), fake bookings, or payment manipulation.

section27.title: 27. Violation of Rules
section27.content: The platform has the right to: Cancel bookings, freeze balances, and block accounts.

section28.title: 28. Driver Role
section28.content: On the platform, a Driver: Creates trips, sets prices, and accepts passengers. The driver is fully responsible for their trips.

section29.title: 29. Trip Creation Rules
section29.content: Drivers must correctly enter: Route, Time, Price per seat, and Available seats. Prohibited: Re-creating the same trip or creating overlapping trips. If violated, the trip will not be created.

section30.title: 30. Driver Trip View Rights
section30.content: Drivers can view only their own trips and filter by Active / Completed / Cancelled.

section31.title: 31. Trip Statuses (for Drivers)
section31.content: active → bookings accepted, full → no seats, completed → finished, cancelled → aborted.

section32.title: 32. Cancelling a Trip (MOST IMPORTANT)
section32.content: If a driver cancels a trip: 1. All bookings are cancelled and clients receive refunds. 2. Clients receive compensation based on a percentage. 3. Money is deducted from the driver (Booking amount, commission, and compensation).

section33.title: 33. Financial Responsibility (for Drivers)
section33.content: If a driver cancels a trip, they pay: Full refund to clients, additional compensation, and platform service fee. Total loss = total_price + client_compensation + company_fee.

section34.title: 34. Negative Balance (VERY IMPORTANT)
section34.content: A driver's balance may become negative (-). The platform will deduct this from future payments or block the account.

section35.title: 35. Client Compensation
section35.content: If a trip is cancelled by the driver, the client receives a 100% refund plus additional compensation.

section36.title: 36. Platform Commission
section36.content: When a trip is cancelled, the platform may retain its commission or perform a recalculation.

section37.title: 37. Driver Restrictions
section37.content: Drivers must not: Cancel trips without justification, create fake trips, or mislead clients.

section38.title: 38. Driver Account Blocking
section38.content: Accounts will be blocked for: Excessive cancellations, incorrect information, or financial manipulation.

section39.title: 39. Expired Trips
section39.content: Cancelled trips are stored separately for audit and history purposes.

section40.title: 40. Transactions
section40.content: Every action is recorded: Debit (deduction) and Credit (addition). The driver consents to this.

section41.title: 41. Platform Rights
section41.content: Ketamiz.com has the right to: Manually cancel trips, freeze balances, and change commissions.

section42.title: 42. Registration and SMS Verification
section42.content: When registering, users must enter a phone number which must be verified via SMS (OTP). Unverified accounts cannot book or create trips.

section43.title: 43. Phone Number Usage
section43.content: Users consent to their phone number being used for: SMS verification, booking notifications, trip changes, and driver/client communication.

section44.title: 44. Driver and Client Communication
section44.content: If a booking is confirmed, the platform may provide the phone numbers of the client and driver to each other to facilitate the trip.

section45.title: 45. SMS Notifications
section45.content: The platform may send SMS for: New bookings, cancellations, passenger updates, trip cancellations, and payment changes.

section46.title: 46. Privacy
section46.content: Phone numbers are only shared between users associated with a trip and are not given to third parties (unless legally required).

section47.title: 47. User Obligations
section47.content: Users must not use other users' phone numbers for: Spam, marketing, or sharing with third parties.

section48.title: 48. Platform Responsibility (Communication)
section48.content: Ketamiz.com is not responsible for phone communication between users and only provides the means of contact.

section49.title: 49. Misuse
section49.content: Prohibited: SMS spam, fake numbers, or harassing other users. Results in account blocking.
